name: Origami
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sheet of folded paper rendered as a regular diagonal crease grid split into beveled triangular facets, each a flat shaded plane. A single raking light sweeps across so mountain and valley folds catch and surrender the light in turn, crisp highlights riding every crease. The pattern is a strict triangular fold grid, not a random tiling, so the whole sheet reads as one cleanly creased plane turning under the light — and an optional ripple can let it fold organically.

params.label: Fold size
params.effect: Size of each fold cell in CSS pixels — a finely creased tessellation at the low end, a few big bold facets at the high end.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Shading contrast between facets facing toward and away from the light — a flat paper at 0, a deeply folded relief at 1.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Width and brightness of the lit crease lines — barely-there hairlines at 0, thick glowing fold edges at 1.

params.label: Light sweep
params.effect: How fast the raking light travels around the sheet — a fixed lighting at 0, a steadily turning glint at full.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Overall luminance lift on the facets and creases — a dim charcoal fold at 0, a bright luminous sheet at 1.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far colour travels across the sheet diagonally — a single-tinted paper near 0, a full spectral fold at the high end.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole folded sheet, from an upright grid to a diagonal lattice of creases.

params.label: Tone variation
params.effect: How widely the flat facet tones spread apart — an even sheet at 0, neighbouring planes reading at strongly different angles at 1.

params.label: Ripple
params.effect: Bends the crease grid into a slowly rippling fold — a ruler-straight tessellation at 0, an organically buckled sheet at 1.
